summary: Make long Telegram runs visibly report verified progress
description: Repair and harden gateway long-run observability so Telegram users receive reliable periodic health updates and durable top-level milestone messages without relying on manual /steer self-report. Keep status delivery best-effort and outside the model's final-answer path.
acceptance: Telegram long-running notifications remain visible and thread-correct; an explicit milestone emitted during a run is delivered as a durable separate message while heartbeat stays edit-in-place; notification failures never abort execution; configured platform overrides are covered by regression tests.
verification: python -m pytest tests/gateway/test_display_config.py tests/gateway -k 'long_running or milestone or heartbeat' -o 'addopts=' -q; bash scripts/validate-go.sh

evidence.summary: RED: milestone, heartbeat activity-age, stall detection, cleanup durability, and copy-pack compatibility tests failed before implementation. GREEN: focused gateway verification 25 passed/1 skipped; milestone unit tests 6 passed; broader affected regression suite 329 passed. Static: git diff --check, py_compile, Bertus JSON validation, go-workflow validation all passed. Devil review: durable milestones only after successful workflow mutation; untrusted task IDs rejected; notification delivery remains fail-open; milestones remain thread-correct and exempt from cleanup.
